versions.content: If a P-port specified by a ModeSwitchInterface is connected to an R-port with an incompatible interface and a ModeInterfaceMapping for both interfaces is associated with the connection, the RTE of the ECU implementing the R-port shall map and convert the mode elements of the sender's interface to the mode elements of the receiver's interface.
